They were led by third-year head coach [[Andy Enfield]]. They played their home games at the [[Galen Center]] and were members of the [[Pac-12 Conference men's basketball|Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–13, 9–9 in Pac-12 play to finish in a three-way tie for sixth place. They defeated [[2015–16 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]] in the first round of the [[2016 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to advance to the quarterfinals where they lost to [[2015–16 Utah Utes men's basketball team|Utah]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2016 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] where they lost in the first round to [[2015-16 Providence Friars men's basketball team|Providence]]. == Previous season == The [[2014–15 USC Trojans men's basketball team|2014–15 USC Trojans]] finished the season with an overall record of 12–20, and 3–15 in the Pac-12 regular season. In the [[2015 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|2015 Pac-12 tournament]], the Trojans defeated [[2014–15 Arizona State Sun Devils men's basketball team|Arizona State]], 67–64 in the first round, before losing to [[2014–15 UCLA Bruins men's basketball team|UCLA]], 96–70 in the quarterfinal.
